channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: What Would Happen If The NHL Playoffs Started Today?
item.description: Ryan Kennedy, Michael Traikos and Michael Augello discuss Alex Ovechkin's future, what the playoffs would look like if they started today, prospect news and much more.

item.title: Predicting NCAA's Hobey Baker Hat Trick Finalists: McKenna, Wyttenbach Highlight Top 10
item.description: Just being a top-three finalist for the Hobey Baker Award is a huge accomplishment in NCAA men's hockey. Tony Ferrari examines the top 10 to predict who will make the next cut.

item.title: The Vancouver Canucks Flip-Flopped Hard This Season. Will It Pay Off?
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks went from hoping for a bounce-back season to trading parts of their core and beginning a rebuild. Here's how they ended up being eliminated from playoff contention and what comes next.

item.title: What Top NHL Prospect Anton Frondell Brings To The Blackhawks Right Now
item.description: Chicago Blackhawks top prospect Anton Frondell is expected to make his NHL debut this week. Based on what he's shown in the Swedish League and in his career to date, he should bring a jolt of energy to the Hawks.

item.title: Bruins Top Prospect James Hagens To Join AHL Providence On ATO
item.description: James Hagens is set to join the AHL's Providence Bruins on an amateur tryout after his NCAA season ended.

item.title: If The NHL Draft Implemented The Gold Plan, The Canucks Would Have A Head Start
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks are eliminated from playoff contention, and finishing last would improve their chances of drafting first overall. If the NHL used the Gold Plan, the Canucks would still have every reason to win.

item.title: Top NHL Prospects In Future Watch 2026: 81 To 100
item.description: Prospects on the Maple Leafs, Canadiens, Oilers, Ducks, Red Wings and more feature from 81st to 100th in The Hockey News' Future Watch ranking.

item.title: NHL Vezina Trophy Rankings: Two Russian Stars Battle For The Lead
item.description: New York Islanders goalie Ilya Sorokin and Tampa Bay Lightning starter Andrei Vasilevskiy are making very strong cases for winning the Vezina Trophy, as voted on by NHL GMs.

item.title: The Wraparound: Reflecting On Paul Maurice's Coaching Legacy Ahead Of 2,000th Game
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Jim Parsons discuss Mika Zibanejad's future, Paul Maurice's 2,000th NHL game, Cole Caufield, Lindy Ruff, James Hagens and more.

item.title: Should Mika Zibanejad Remain On The New York Rangers Long-Term?
item.description: New York Rangers star center Mika Zibanejad reached the 1,000-game plateau Monday. Could Zibanejad's next milestone come as a member of a different team?

item.title: Golden Knights Star Mitch Marner Must Improve By The Playoffs
item.description: What matters most is how Mitch Marner produces in the Stanley Cup playoffs. But his drop in scoring this season should put pressure on him to up his game by the post-season.

item.title: Capitals' Pierre-Luc Dubois Ejected For Intent To Injure Blues' Robert Thomas
item.description: Washington Capitals center Pierre-Luc Dubois was assessed a match penalty for appearing to pull St. Louis Blues center Robert Thomas to the ice.

item.title: ﻿Blue Jackets Continue Amazing Turnaround Under Bowness: 'He's Definitely Played A Huge Part'
item.description: The Columbus Blue Jackets' bounceback under coach Rick Bowness has brought them from the depths of the Eastern Conference to near the top of the Metropolitan Division. Their win in Philadelphia showed how.

item.title: The Sky Remains The Limit For Blackhawks' Connor Bedard
item.description: Connor Bedard may not be getting as much attention as Macklin Celebrini and Matthew Schaefer. But he's added a crucial element to his game this season, putting his superstar potential back on track.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Latest Buzz On Canucks' Elias Pettersson And Flyers
item.description: What to do with struggling center Elias Pettersson will be a key off-season issue for the Vancouver Canucks. Meanwhile, the rebuilding Philadelphia Flyers could be in the market for a center this summer.
